title: Piece of crap!!
text: Piece of crap!!. I recieved this today and one of the rods were broken (doesn't twist in or out), fortunately I really only needed one and it barely holds. They are very cheaply made and to my surprise (🤔) the instructions were in Chinese. Amazon, stop selling this crap!
